mapper.select: SELECT *, (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS unlocked, next_check_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AS due FROM provider_balance_monitor WHERE monitor_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_balance_monitor SET lease_token=#{token},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE monitor_key=#{key}
mapper.select: SELECT *,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AS observed_at FROM provider_balance_monitor WHERE monitor_key=#{key} AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FOR UPDATE
SELECT last_checked_at FROM provider_balance_monitor WHERE monitor_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_balance_monitor SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE monitor_key=#{key} AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND alert_state='low' AND alert_id=#{alertId} AND alert_sent_at IS NULL

UPDATE provider_balance_monitor SET alert_sent_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),last_notified_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE monitor_key=#{key} AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND alert_id=#{alertId} AND alert_state='low'

UPDATE provider_balance_monitor SET next_check_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{seconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), failure_count=0,last_error_code=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE monitor_key=#{key} AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE provider_balance_monitor SET failure_count=failure_count+1,last_error_code=#{error}, next_check_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{seconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE monitor_key=#{key} AND lease_token=#{token} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
